which sizes of the holograms do you want? nearly all of this holograms have been produced in different sizes in the late 80s. some of these may also be produced 

on glass and on film, where the glass ones are more brilliant. 

if you want very big ones or some on glass plates, i think you will only find them at collectors or museums.
